title: Daily NK — 'New satellite images reveal upgrades, freight activity at North Korea's Pyongsan uranium plant'
snippet: New satellite imagery reveals significant infrastructure upgrades and increased freight activity at North Korea's Pyongsan uranium refinery, the country's only known facility for producing uranium yellowcake — the milled uranium ore concentrate that serves as the starting material for highly enriched uranium used in nuclear weapons. The upgrades and expanding waste deposits suggest increased production activity.
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 평산 우라늄 정련공장 위성영상 분석 보도 없음. 영변 농축시설에 집중된 기존 보도와 달리 원료 공급 단계(yellowcake 생산)의 확장을 보여주는 새로운 정보.
